# nuthatch nest on base-sepolia

A self-hosted blockchain index. Query it locally; there is no third-party API.

## Contracts
- `router` = 0xc8c614C5Ef7823F4E0E6baf3EbC4593d089c7F22
- `quota` = 0xEE987052Ac1840AAd96eF322822C664616c15C66
- `aqua` = 0xFfdD1873f99EA128DED0BFc2Ae11A98f572E23Ec
- `vault_router` = 0x503a9d46da9a9b1d7edf798f4cef2e49f296e0ce
- `vault_quota` = 0x83644E4C17BA1ffDf38436a10a610F1325d9Bb0a
- `identity_mirror` = 0x70b9FE7Bd162B0014df1E1f435dB47765Db62455
- `faucet` = 0x1aA651B3fd14F8242b13759c56d73E48800fEF2a

## Tables (one per contract event)
- `aqua__docked` - Docked(address,address,bytes32) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, maker, app, strategyHash)
- `aqua__shipped` - Shipped(address,address,bytes32,bytes) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, maker, app, strategyHash, strategy)
- `faucet__claimed` - Claimed(address,uint256,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, account, amount0, amount1, nextClaimAt)
- `identity_mirror__human_mirrored` - HumanMirrored(address,uint256,uint256,bytes32) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, agent, humanId, sourceBlock, sourceBlockHash)
- `quota__fee_schedule_updated` - FeeScheduleUpdated(address,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, token, tightFeeBps, wideFeeBps, tightVolume, wideVolume, humanShareBps)
- `quota__risk_policy_applied` - RiskPolicyApplied(address,uint256,bytes32,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, token, indexedThroughBlock, decisionHash, desiredTightFeeBps, riskSpreadBps, tightFeeBps, wideFeeBps)
- `quota__usage_recorded` - UsageRecorded(uint256,address,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, humanId, token, amount, day)
- `router__human_gated` - HumanGated(bytes32,address,uint256,bool,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, orderHash, taker, humanId, tight, feeE9)
- `router__swapped` - Swapped(bytes32,address,address,address,address,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, orderHash, maker, taker, tokenIn, tokenOut, amountIn, amountOut)
- `vault_quota__fee_schedule_updated` - FeeScheduleUpdated(address,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, token, tightFeeBps, wideFeeBps, tightVolume, wideVolume, humanShareBps)
- `vault_quota__risk_policy_applied` - RiskPolicyApplied(address,uint256,bytes32,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, token, indexedThroughBlock, decisionHash, desiredTightFeeBps, riskSpreadBps, tightFeeBps, wideFeeBps)
- `vault_quota__usage_recorded` - UsageRecorded(uint256,address,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, humanId, token, amount, day)
- `vault_router__human_gated` - HumanGated(bytes32,address,uint256,bool,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, orderHash, taker, humanId, tight, feeE9)
- `vault_router__swapped` - Swapped(bytes32,address,address,address,address,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, orderHash, maker, taker, tokenIn, tokenOut, amountIn, amountOut)

## Live HTTP API (run `nuthatch dev`)
- `GET /`                    index status
- `GET /tables`              every table with its columns
- `GET /table/{name}?limit=N` recent rows of one table (hot + sealed)
- `GET /entity/{id}`         one row by id (`{block:012}-{logindex:06}`)
- `GET /sql?q=SELECT...`     read-only SQL; each table is a view named `{alias}__{event}`
- `GET /balances?limit=N`    top holder balances (when an ERC-20 Transfer table is present)
- `GET /balance/{address}`   one address's derived balance

## MCP (for coding agents)
Run `nuthatch mcp` (stdio) to expose tools: status, schema, tables, table, sql, entity,
balance, top_balances. Fully offline against the local instance; nothing phones home.
